t: This is Craven Street, a street in the City of Westminster, close to the Strand. It's best known as the London home of Benjamin Franklin, in the years before the American Revolution, and several other notable people have lived along it. The person we can name here is James Wedderburn, a Scottish army surgeon, born in 1814, who died on this street in 1863. So alongside the famous American resident, the street also holds the quieter story of a military doctor's final years.
